name: Ambessa
title: Matriarch of War

Q.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
Q.description: Cunning Sweep: Ambessa sweeps her blades forward, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 + 0.6×bonus AD + 0.04/0.045/0.05/0.055/0.06 + 0.0×bonus AD max Health physical damage to enemies at the edge of the strike. All other enemies take 0.5 damage. Striking an enemy readies a Sundering Slam. Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.9×bonus AD + 0.04/0.045/0.05/0.055/0.06 + 0.0×bonus AD max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take 0.5 damage.
Q.summary: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

W.name: Repudiation
W.description: Ambessa gains 50–320 (by level) + 1.5×bonus AD Shield for 1.5 seconds and braces herself for 0.5 seconds. She then slams the ground, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage to nearby enemies, which increases to (50/75/100/125/150 + 0.5×bonus AD) × 1.5 physical damage if she braced herself from damage from an enemy champion, large monster, or structure.
W.summary: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

E.name: Lacerate
E.description: Ambessa whips her chains around, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage and Slowing enemies by 99%, which decays over 1 second. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this Ability will trigger an additional strike.
E.summary: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

R.name: Public Execution
R.description: Passive: Ambessa gains 10/20/30% %i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration and her Abilities heal her for 0.15/0.175/0.2 + 0.5×stat of the damage she dealt. Active: Ambessa becomes Unstoppable and blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line, Suppressing the target for 0.75 seconds and then slamming them into the ground, dealing 150/250/350 + 0.8×bonus AD physical damage and Stunning them for 0.4 seconds.
R.summary: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

Passive.name: Drakehound's Step
Passive.description: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.
Passive.summary: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Energy-based skirmisher who weaves short dashes (passive) between abilities to stick to targets, then suppresses and stuns one champion with R.
strengths: Constant small dashes make her hard to kite
Shield from W blocks a trade's burst and punishes it
R is a guaranteed lockdown on a chosen target
Strong extended trades once all abilities are up
weaknesses: Dashes are short; hard engages can be dodged
Short melee range before passive dash
Falls behind if she can't get on top of ranged champions

curve.lvl1: medium – Q sweep plus passive dash trades fine
curve.lvl3: strong – full combo with W shield
curve.late: medium – one-target lockdown, dives the backline

profile.curveNote: Combo relies on chaining abilities for passive dashes; level 3 is her real trading start.
profile.waveClear: medium – Q and E are area damage
profile.sustain: low-medium – Q heals on hit (check scope)
profile.mobility: high – passive dash after every ability, R blink

Q.notes: Area damage; second cast transforms after hitting

W.answer: shield + bonus damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing
W.notes: Bait damage into it before trading

R.notes: Unstoppable blink to the farthest champion in a line, then suppress + stun

Passive.notes: Dash after casting with a move/attack command; empowers next attack

profile.windowAgainst: Energy low or W down (no damage block); R down means no guaranteed lockdown.
checks: Q heal scope and passive energy refund details
